title: Dichotomous behavior of water in binary mixtures with a turning point between 40 and 60 °C
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,20542-20551
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03224E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Amiya Atahar, Noushaba Nusrat Mafy, Mohammad Hossain, Md. Abu Bin Hasan Susan
Dichotomous behavior of water between 40 and 60 °C was studied in pure form and mixtures through analysis of particle size, specific gravity, and NIR spectra, revealing a pseudo-phase transition within this temperature range.
